Methodology & Data Notes

This report is derived from a dataset of 50,000 chocolate retail transactions spanning January 2023 through December 2024.

  • Revenue is calculated as quantity × unit_price × (1 − discount), per the dataset specification.
  • Profit is calculated as revenue − cost, per the dataset specification.
  • Profit margin is computed as profit / revenue × 100.
  • Discount tiers are binned: No Discount (0%), 1–5%, 6–10%, 11–15%, 16–20%, 20%+.
  • Customer segments are defined by total order count: One-time (1), Low (2–5), Medium (6–20), High (21+).
  • Product, store, and customer dimension tables (names, brands, categories, demographics, loyalty status) were not available in the provided data. Analyses that would depend on these attributes are noted accordingly.
  • All figures are derived directly from the transaction data — no values have been fabricated or estimated.
